name: A Light in the Darkness
statusNote: New in Forever.  From Wowhead’s Forever database.
footerSourceNote: This quest is new in Forever: its text, givers, objectives and rewards come from Wowhead’s Forever database until the beta confirms them. Quest text © Blizzard Entertainment.

narrative.details:
Greetings, champion. Yes, I am a paladin. Not even death can stop the Light.

This my kind have in common with all Forsaken--we have overcome what the living view as their end. However, some even among our own fear us; they suspect we will smite them as some monstrosity.

In truth, our relationship with undeath is complex, but I am not here to hurt our own. Help me show the others this. Venture to Night's Web Hollow to the northwest and free the freshly raised fools trapped by the spiders there.
narrative.objectives: Free 6 Webbed Victims in Night's Web Hollow for Aramis Hammerhand in Deathknell.
narrative.offerRewardText: May this help Executor Arren and so many others see our true nature. Much like in our past lives, we live to serve our people--to protect them with the gifts the Light provides us.They will see in time that we are just as valuable to the Dark Lady's plans as any other.Light be with you.
narrative.requestItemsText: Have you freed the poor, unfortunate souls trapped in that cave?
